release_notes: Vira MangaTranslatorStudio 1.0.1 — clean-brush and inpainting polish: brush marks are analyzed against their own surroundings (no more wrong-color floods), brush strokes draw smoothly with lag-free preview and erase ~8px beyond the line, auto blocks erase with the tight mask, plus opt-in PIN-gated LAN access from phones/tablets, export toasts with one-click download, one-click diagnostics export, RTL toggle fixes, and self-repairing inpaint padding defaults.
